title: Market Chatter: Kuwait Petroleum Held Talks With Investors Over Potential $7 Billion Pipeline Deal
title_zh: 市场热议：科威特石油公司与投资者就潜在的 70 亿美元管道交易进行会谈
summary: Kuwait Petroleum had early talks with investors like BlackRock (BLK), KKR (KKR), EIG Partners, and B
summary_zh: 科威特石油公司与 BlackRock (BLK)、KKR (KKR)、EIG Partners 和 B 等投资者进行了早期谈判

title: Salesforce AI Deals Test Investor Patience As Valuation Screens Attractive
title_zh: Salesforce AI 交易考验投资者耐心，估值极具吸引力
summary: Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) is expanding its AI footprint through the acquisition of Momentum to strengthen conversational and unstructured data ingestion for Agentforce and Slackbot.
summary_zh: Salesforce（纽约证券交易所股票代码：CRM）正在通过收购 Momentum 来扩大其人工智能足迹，以加强 Agentforce 和 Slackbot 的对话式和非结构化数据摄取。

title: Nebius Tavily Deal Links AI Agents To Growing Cloud Infrastructure
title_zh: Nebius Tavily 交易将人工智能代理与不断发展的云基础设施联系起来
summary: Nebius Group (NasdaqGS:NBIS) has acquired Tavily, a provider of agentic search software for AI agents in financial trading and coding. The company is expanding its AI infrastructure and data center footprint to support growing demand from enterprise customers.
summary_zh: Nebius Group（纳斯达克GS：NBIS）收购了Tavily，这是一家为金融交易和编码领域的人工智能代理提供代理搜索软件的提供商。该公司正在扩大其人工智能基础设施和数据中心的覆盖范围，以满足企业客户不断增长的需求。

title: Paramount raises bid for Warner Bros in attempt to block Netflix takeover
title_zh: 派拉蒙提高对华纳兄弟的出价，试图阻止 Netflix 收购
summary: Larry Ellison’s Paramount has fired the starting gun on a blockbuster bidding war for Warner Bros after tabling a last-ditch takeover offer.
summary_zh: 拉里·埃里森 (Larry Ellison) 的派拉蒙 (Paramount) 在提出最后一搏收购要约后，打响了对华纳兄弟 (Warner Bros) 轰动一时的竞购战的发令枪。

title: Paramount submits higher offer for Warner Bros Discovery in bid to block Netflix, source says
title_zh: 消息人士称，派拉蒙向华纳兄弟探索公司提出更高的报价，以阻止 Netflix
summary: By Dawn Chmielewski Feb 23 (Reuters) - Paramount Skydance submitted a higher offer for Warner Bros Discovery, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters on Monday, ratcheting up efforts to derail
summary_zh: 路透社 2 月 23 日报道 - 一位知情人士周一告诉路透社，派拉蒙 Skydance 向华纳兄弟探索公司提出了更高的收购要约，加大了阻止其出轨的力度。
